evidence_quote: alias 'OpenAI' currently matches every 'Azure OpenAI' string
proposed_alias_replacement: Drop the bare 'OpenAI' alias from product 1168 OpenAI API. The alias is matching ~17 of 22 gap rows that are actually Azure OpenAI deployments. Replace with: keep 'OpenAI API' alias only, plus add narrowly-scoped aliases like 'OpenAI direct API', 'api.openai.com', 'openai.com API'. Also: when matching 'OpenAI API', exclude rows where the same field also contains 'Azure OpenAI API' (the Azure-managed wrapper).
notes: Root cause: bare 'OpenAI' is a substring of 'Azure OpenAI', so the populate matcher correctly skipped these (they're Azure deployments, not direct OpenAI corp API), but the audit's free-text search counts them as gaps. Tightening the alias eliminates the false signal and prevents future incorrect links.
